summary.text: Jonathan Fallon is the Republican candidate for Maine State Senate District 34 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Daniel Sayre (D) for a seat with no incumbent.
Ballotpedia describes him as an attorney and business owner who serves as a U.S. Air Force JAG officer.

paragraphs.text: Fallon earned a bachelor's degree from Manhattanville University, a graduate degree from Boston University and a law degree from Suffolk University Law School, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia says he joined the U.S. Air Force in 2012 and served as a JAG officer.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Fallon said he has served more than 14 years in the Air Force, presently serves in the reserve as a JAG officer and is part owner of a small business in Kennebunk.
Ballotpedia lists Fallon as a 2024 candidate for the Kennebunk Select Board.
He advanced from the Republican primary for Senate District 34 on June 9, 2026, with 4,001 votes in an uncontested primary.

In the survey, Fallon named three campaign messages: coalition building, lowering the cost of living, and supporting teachers with higher pay and training for an environment shaped by artificial intelligence.
